description: Archbishop of Colombo v. Minister of Education & Others Archbishop of Colombo v. Minister of Education & Others View More before Hon. L.U. Jayasuriya, J
parties: Archbishop of Colombo v. Minister of Education & Others Archbishop of Colombo v. Minister of Education & Others View More
keywords: Writ of Prohibition – Former Roman Catholic school property – Property originally vested in State for school administration – Subsequent relocation of upper-school classes – Divesting order published in Gazette – Minister later seeking to cancel/revoke divesting order – Whether statutory power to issue an order includes power to revoke it – Interpretation Ordinance – Alleged misrepresentation in obtaining divesting order – Scope of ministerial power to rescind administrative order.
legistation: Constitution – Article 140; Assisted Schools and Training Colleges (Special Provisions) Act No. 5 of 1961, as amended; judgment also refers to Act No. 8 of 1961 when discussing divesting power; Interpretation Ordinance – section 18.
